proposed.decision: intent + all anchor groups + single verified fact + typed exact value + conservative residual guard

policy: Freeze before first evaluation run. Evaluation labels must not be used to tune rules or thresholds. Future changes require a new independent evaluation version. Correct software defects using unit tests; report inspection and synthetic origin transparently.
abstention: undetermined is a wrong prediction against the three gold labels; also report insufficient + undetermined as no conclusive truth decision
